issuer.identityAnchor: The Karur Vysya Bank Limited (‘the Bank’)

regulator.denominator: Working funds to be reckoned as average of total assets (excluding accumulated losses, if any) as reported to RBI in Form X for Commercial Banks during the 12 months of the financial year.
regulator.roa: Return on Assets would be with reference to average working funds (i.e., total of assets excluding accumulated losses, if any).
regulator.commencement: These Directions shall come into force with immediate effect.
